subject: Per-token bands, commit tiers & model surcharge — clarification for StratifyAI pilot
messages:
From: Anna Li <anna@stratify.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: StratifyAI Procurement <procurement@stratify.ai>
Date: 2026-11-28T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Clarify per-token bands + model premium for Stratify pilot

Hi Olga —

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. Procurement asked for a clean breakdown of how Redwood applies volume discounts and where model-specific premiums land. A couple of specific asks to help our Finance/ML teams: 

- For hosted API usage: what are the commit bands (tokens/month) you recommend for a small pilot vs production? Please show the per-token list price and the discounted price at each band.
- How do you treat premium models vs standard ones? Are premiums a multiplier on per-token pricing or an additive surcharge?
- Embeddings vs chat: we have a mix (about 60% chat, 40% embeddings estimated). Do embeddings use the same token accounting or a different unit?
- Any minimum commit or upfront required to get the stated discounts?

I attached our internal MAAP (StratifyAI_MAAP_v2.pdf) with expected monthly token ranges. Ideally we can get a short one-page summary and an example pricing calc for our projected first 3 months.

Appreciate it — can you send before EOD Monday PST?

Best,
Anna Li
Head of ML Infrastructure
StratifyAI

Attachments: StratifyAI_MAAP_v2.pdf (1.2MB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Li <anna@stratify.ai>
Cc: StratifyAI Procurement <procurement@stratify.ai>
Date: 2026-11-28T18:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify per-token bands + model premium for Stratify pilot

Hi Anna —

Thanks for the clear asks and for sharing the MAAP. Attached is a compact summary (redwood_commit_summary.xlsx) and a short handwritten example below — will follow with a formatted PDF by tomorrow morning. Quick TL;DR first:

- Commit bands (hosted per-token list before discount): base list = $0.0006 / token for standard chat models.
- Model premium treatment: multiplier on the base per-token. Premium chat models = 3.0x by default; near-premium = 2.0x. Embeddings: billed per 1k-embedding-units = base*0.5 (i.e., cheaper per token-equivalent).
- Volume discounts: standard band discounts off list (examples below). Discounts apply to the blended usage after model multipliers are applied.

Example pricing (monthly usage):
- Band definitions (tokens/month): Starter: 0 - 1M ; Growth: 1M - 5M ; Scale: 5M+
- Discount schedule (off list): Starter 5%; Growth 15%; Scale 24%

Sample calc (month with 2M tokens, 60% chat std, 40% embeddings):
1) Compute nominal cost before discount:
   - Chat standard: 1.2M tokens * $0.0006 = $720.
   - Embeddings: 0.8M tokens -> billed as 800 embedding-units at base*0.5 -> equivalent nominal $0.0003 per token => 0.8M * $0.0003 = $240.
   - Subtotal nominal = $960.
2) Model premiums: if you use a premium model for 20% of chat traffic (e.g., 20% of 1.2M tokens), premium multiplier 3.0x applies only to those tokens. Adjust nominal before discount accordingly.
3) Apply blended discount for Growth band (15%) to the adjusted nominal -> final.

Minimums & commits: to lock the Growth/Scale discounts we ask for a 3-month rolling commit for Starter/Growth and a 12-month commitment for Scale band with monthly reporting. A small pilot (30 days, capped at 2M tokens) can be done with a 25% trial discount on usage (no long-term commit).

Next steps I suggest:
- If you want the Growth schedule for month 1 only, I can give an exact dollar estimate using your MAAP numbers (will do that tomorrow).
- If Procurement wants a quick commercial structure, I can loop in Rishi for an approval on any one-off blended rates.

Attaching: redwood_commit_summary.xlsx (pricing matrix + sample calc).

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_commit_summary.xlsx (10KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: StratifyAI — ask for approval on blended pilot discount

Rishi / Marissa —

Quick ask: StratifyAI is asking for a clear pricing summary (attached to me) and a 30-day pilot option capped at 2M tokens. My standard pilot offer is a 25% trial discount with no commit. They are asking whether we can instead offer a blended rate that treats embeddings at half-cost and caps premium model surcharge at 2.5x (vs our standard 3x) for the pilot month to reduce sticker shock.

If we agree to 2.5x for premium on the pilot only, I can close the pilot next week and pursue a 12-month Scale commit after they validate latency/quality with our dedicated routing. The deal currently has estimated ARR potential $600k+/yr if they convert.

Can we approve: 25% off usage OR blended pilot with premium capped at 2.5x and the Growth discounts (15%) applied?

Thanks —
Olga

(Internal attachment: redwood_commit_summary.xlsx)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: StratifyAI — ask for approval on blended pilot discount

Olga / Marissa —

Approved with constraints. For a short pilot (30 days, <= 2M tokens) we can support the blended pilot terms you propose with these guardrails: 

- Base list and multipliers we publish remain: base list $0.0006 / token; premium default 3.0x; embeddings baseline 0.5x.
- Pilot concession: cap premium multiplier to 2.5x for the single pilot month only.
- Apply standard Growth band discounts (15%) to the blended nominal before the pilot concession is applied.
- Pricing floor: total pilot invoice must be >= $7,500 (to cover minimum infra reservation).
- To qualify for Scale band (24% discount) they must sign a 12-month commit with minimum $75k/mo equivalent usage or a negotiated reserved GPU capacity order.
- Include an automatic fallback clause: if a premium model used in the pilot becomes unavailable, route to a near-premium at 2.0x and credit for any degraded SLOs per usual SLA.

Olga — please confirm the final numbers back to the customer. Laura, tagging you for awareness on the minimum invoice floor.

Rishi
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Please send a short SOW and DocuSign for the pilot; procurement will sign once the SOW lists the cap and trial discount and includes the fallback clause you outlined.

Scheduling: can we have kickoff on Dec 7th (our engineers + your solutions engineer) — 30-45 minute sync?

Forwarding your note to procurement below for visibility.
